 Fox News host seemingly gives up on Republican midterms success mid-broadcast
 Rachel Dobkin Tuesday 03 November 2026 20:30 EST 
 Bookmark popover
 Removed from bookmarks
 Close popover Trump makes absurd claim about Greenland in closing midterms pitch Fox News host Jesse Watters expressed pessimism on-air about the midterm election outcomes before polls even closed. 
 Speaking on The Five, Watters admitted he felt Republicans were poised for losses, particularly voicing concern over control of the Senate . 
 Democrats are seeking to secure majorities by flipping three seats in the House of Representatives and four in the Senate. 
 President Donald Trump heavily campaigned for Republican candidates in red states where Democrats made polling gains. 
 Watters noted that the difficult night for Republicans was anticipated, questioning only how severe the outcome would be.
